No gate results yet.

- T-03 R1-04 (minor, open) api/customer.go:53-54: The default branch of writeUsersError, rewritten in this diff, returns err.Error() to the HTTP caller. For a transport failure that text is the wrapped url.Error from Fetch, for example "users unreachable - get user c-7 - Get http://user-svc:8080/v1/users/c-7 - dial tcp ... connection refused" or a client timeout message, which discloses the internal users-service host, port, IP and path layout to any caller of the orders endpoint. Customer profile v2 (CHG-001) in users. Spec: `spec/users.md`.

## Why

The PRD: `prd/v1.md`.

## What changed

- `api/` (3 files, 166 lines)

## Blast radius

Risk level: MEDIUM. Details: `blast-radius.md` in the change folder.

## Decisions

- D-1 Should GET /v2/users/{id} return exactly what GET /v1/users/{id} returns today, or read the stored profile? → a (human)
- D-2 The new public route /profile/v2/users/{id} rests on unverified facts about the live gateway (routing, auth, rate limits). How should the plan proceed? → a (human)
- D-3 PRD-3.4 says each service may be deployed on its own, in the safe order. Must orders stay safe if it reaches prod before users serves v2? → a (human)
- D-4 Open PR acme/users#812 (Normalise phone formats) touches users api/user.go, where the users routes are registered. How should the v2 endpoint coexist with it? → a (human)
- D-5 Which gateway prefix carries the v2 profile? → Mount only the prefix /profile/v2/users/ on the gateway, routed to user-svc:8080 with /profile stripped, so /profile/v2/users/{id} reaches GET /v2/users/{id}. Do not mount /profile/ as a whole. (athel)
- D-6 How is the later removal of GET /v1/users/{id} handled in this change? → v1 stays fully unchanged in this change. Its removal is planned as a deferred contract task, to be drafted only once no caller remains; the known remaining callers after this change are notifications (about 6 req/min, metrics only, out of scope per PRD-4.2) and the public gateway path /users/v1/users/{id}. (athel)
- D-7 Does the orders client keep a v1 method? → Orders switches clients.Users.Get to GET /v2/users/{id} in place; no v1 method is kept for the live path. The dormant LegacyProfile call is left untouched. (athel)
- D-8 Someone else is working on files this change plans to edit in users. How should Athel go on? → b (human)

## Tests and gates

No gate results yet.

Open minor and nit review findings (they never block a task; doc 06):

- T-02 R1-01 (minor, open) api/user.go:1-1: The package doc comment says the package serves /v1/users, which this change makes inaccurate now that Register also adds GET /v2/users/{id}.

## Waivers

None.

## Security notes

No security report yet.

## Side findings (not fixed here)

- SF-3 (bug, high) github.com/acme/users api/user.go:24-37: getUser encodes a User holding only the path id and reads no store, so GET /v1/users/{id} always returns empty name and phone. putUser only calls events.PublishUserUpdated, which logs, although its comment says it writes users.users.phone, so nothing is persisted. Orders passes this empty profile through to its callers. → not decided yet
- SF-1 (bug, low) github.com/acme/orders clients/backoff.go:6-12: Backoff computes 100*time.Millisecond << n before capping; for n of 37 or more the shift overflows int64 and yields a negative or wrong duration below the 2s cap, and a negative n panics on the shift. → not decided yet
- SF-2 (dead-code, low) github.com/acme/orders clients/users.go:14-17: Users.LegacyProfile calls /v1/users/{id}/legacy-profile, which users removed in 2026-09 (users api/user.go:1); metrics show 0 req/min over 7d, yet its comment says the receipt job still calls it, so either the job is dead or it fails silently with 404. → not decided yet

1. users (not opened yet) (provider, this PR)
2. gateway (not opened yet) (consumer), orders (not opened yet) (consumer): either order
Later, a separate change: users: T-05: Remove GET /v1/users/{id} once no caller remains (deferred contract) (after consumers deploy)
Merge-order rehearsal: not run yet.
